basic_profile.bio: An automation enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who has been exploring the intricacies of Tasker and related apps for several years. By day, I work as a software engineer, and by night, I delve into the world of custom Android automation. I enjoy helping others solve tricky automation problems and often unwind with a good podcast or a documentary. I'm a big fan of weighted blankets and believe in their calming effects. Typically online during the evenings and weekends. Currently in a stable relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I have spent over a decade in software development, specializing in mobile applications. My interest in automation began as a hobby but has since become a significant part of my professional and personal life. I continuously update my skills through online courses and by participating in tech forums.
